description: Find an app the user wants to use from their AI: Gmail, Slack, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Notion, Trello or any of 2,300+ apps. Body { "searchquery": "gmail" } answers services[] with service_id, service_name and service_description. This is the first step whenever the user asks to send, read, create, update or search something in one of their apps, or to automate something across apps. The catalog is public: no sign-in needed for this call.
name: search_apps
